hypothesis: Frozen video representations improve human saliency ranking relative to a matched DeiT control while retaining SUB_C head family and spatial exporter
training: 96 train / 24 dev only; 40 holdout not materialized
target: mean supplied human query-conditioned saliency /4; unannotated 2-second bins masked; not generic negative labels
heads: same TemporalUNet family; input adapter width depends on representation
sampling: 2 FPS decoded frames, output anchor every 4 samples; DeiT single frame, VideoMAE 16-frame centered context, InternVideo2 8-frame centered context; boundary replicate
prediction_construction: existing linear probability interpolation on original PTS
selection: DEV macro Spearman, tie NDCG; no threshold sweep
submission_gate: positive ranking/native signal vs matched DeiT, no F1-only upgrade; then immutable weights/config and raw E2E technical gate
